fields.name: Margarita Pizza
fields.cooking_instructions: Top pizza dough with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil. Bake at 475°F until crust is golden.

fields.name: Caesar Salad
fields.cooking_instructions: Toss romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing, croutons, and parmesan cheese.

fields.name: Beef Stroganoff
fields.cooking_instructions: Cook beef strips with onions and mushrooms. Add sour cream and serve over egg noodles.

fields.name: Lemon Chicken
fields.cooking_instructions: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, garlic, and herbs. Bake until fully cooked.

fields.name: Greek Salad
fields.cooking_instructions: Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, olives, and feta cheese. Dress with olive oil and oregano.

fields.name: Chicken Alfredo
fields.cooking_instructions: Cook pasta and mix with chicken and Alfredo sauce. Garnish with parsley.

fields.name: Pancetta Pasta
fields.cooking_instructions: Cook pasta and toss with pancetta, garlic, and cream sauce. Serve with parmesan cheese.

fields.name: BBQ Ribs
fields.cooking_instructions: Season ribs with BBQ rub and cook slowly in the oven. Finish with BBQ sauce on the grill.

fields.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
fields.cooking_instructions: Fill bell peppers with a mixture of ground beef, rice, and tomato sauce. Bake until tender.

fields.name: Pork Schnitzel
fields.cooking_instructions: Bread and fry pork cutlets. Serve with lemon wedges and a side of potato salad.

fields.name: Apple Crisp
fields.cooking_instructions: Combine apples with sugar and cinnamon. Top with a crumbly mixture of oats and butter. Bake until golden.

fields.name: Thai Green Curry
fields.cooking_instructions: Simmer green curry paste with coconut milk. Add vegetables and chicken or tofu. Serve with rice.

fields.name: Eggplant Parmesan
fields.cooking_instructions: Layer breaded eggplant slices with marinara sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

fields.name: Baked Ziti
fields.cooking_instructions: Mix ziti pasta with marinara sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly and golden.

fields.name: Shrimp Scampi
fields.cooking_instructions: Sauté shrimp in garlic and butter. Toss with pasta and fresh parsley.

fields.name: Vegetable Soup
fields.cooking_instructions: Simmer a variety of vegetables in vegetable broth. Season to taste.
